data.body: **[P2] Exercise the thin-layer runtime before publishing.** Tests are skipped and the later validation only checks ZIP entries. Existing tests obtain OTel dependencies from the test classpath, so they do not prove that this single-JAR layer can be discovered by both the application `ServiceLoader` and agent extension classloader. Add CI coverage that builds this ZIP and verifies a traced invocation using `DURABLE_EXECUTION_PLUGINS` and `OTEL_JAVAAGENT_EXTENSIONS` before publication.
